pools.name: NoSSD
pools.source: NoSSD is a self-pool (fixed payout address): pool_puzzle_hash equals farmer_puzzle_hash on every one of its blocks. NoSSD does not publish a pool_info endpoint. Cross-referenced via nossd.com/blocks: block 9305425 there (header_hash 0x1bde131ffbac39c4d17f7e0bc2d165faf6f2ece57d39136b3afed28c0301dcda) matches Coinset's get_block_record_by_height for that header_hash, whose pool_puzzle_hash is this entry (read 2026-09-17).

pools.name: H9.com
pools.source: H9.com is a self-pool (fixed payout address): pool_puzzle_hash equals farmer_puzzle_hash on every block sampled from Coinset. H9.com's dashboard requires an account, so this address could not be closed-loop verified against their own site; cross-referenced against xchmempool.com's public pool-distribution table (read 2026-09-17), which attributes it to H9.com, and against miningpoolstats.stream/chia, which lists H9.com as a real, large HDD pool.

pools.name: Spacefarmers.io
pools.source: Spacefarmers.io mainly runs the standard PlotNFT pooling protocol, where each farmer's payout address is unique and this registry cannot name it (see registry.ts doc comment). This entry is a separate, fixed self-pool address Spacefarmers.io also operates: pool_puzzle_hash equals farmer_puzzle_hash on every block sampled from Coinset. Cross-referenced against xchmempool.com's public pool-distribution table, which labels it "Spacefarmers.io both shares" (read 2026-09-17).
